title: New Year From Joel (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums family portrait true story brothers New Year intimate unhurried
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar, quiet and late, just before midnight]
New Year's Eve.
Perth time.
Joel called.
No answer.
Left a message instead.

[Verse 1]
Just calling to wish you the best in the new year bro
Love you and miss ya Corey
Give the kids a big cuddle
And a kiss on their forehead
From me
Love your little bro
That's what he said
At ten twenty-three at night
On the last night of the year
From the other side of the country
With a broken leg
From the golf buggy

[Verse 2]
He'd tried to call for three days before that
No answer
Left it
New Year's Eve he tried again
No answer again
Left the message anyway
Because that's what you do
When you love someone
You leave the message
Even if no one picks up
You say the thing
You say it anyway

[Chorus]
Give the kids a cuddle
Kiss on the forehead
From your little bro
Give the kids a cuddle
Love you and miss ya
Happy new year
Give the kids a cuddle
Joel said that
At ten twenty-three
New Year's Eve
From Perth
Broken leg
Didn't matter
Said it anyway

[Bridge - spoken, Joel's voice carried level and warm]
"Love your little bro."
He signed off that way.
Not Joel.
Not his name.
Your little bro.
That's the line that stays.
First grade rugby player.
Rolled two guards.
Three laughing emojis from hospital.
Broke leg from a golf buggy.
And at midnight on New Year's Eve
signs a voicemail:
Love your little bro.
That's the whole man.

[Chorus reprise]
Give the kids a cuddle
Kiss on their forehead
From me
Love you miss ya
Happy new year
Love your little bro

[Outro - guitar alone, fading into the new year]
He called at ten twenty-three
Corey was somewhere across the time zone
The kids got the cuddle
Eventually
And the kiss on the forehead
From Joel
His little bro
Happy new year
